pretreatments.description: Microwave (MW) pretreatment using a household Panasonic microwave oven (1180 W) with a liquid-to-solid ratio of 20:1, pretreatment time of 6 minutes, and power of 600 W, which dissolved the external cell wall of Enteromorpha to release glycoproteins, carbohydrates, and cellulose.

Concentric Co and Ni Metal Nanoparticles Pretreatment where metal nanoparticles (Co and Ni NPs) with average size < 100 nm were added at a concentration of 1 mg/L in a NPs suspension prepared by adding distilled water containing sodium dodecylbenzene sulfonate (SDS) 0.1 mM to the biomass.
